title: Real-Time Elevation and Orientation-Aware Visual Localization for GNSS-Denied Drone Navigation
authors: Fares H.; Mohanna A.; Kaddouh B.
key_contribution: Meets all SLR inclusion criteria for GPS-denied localization/navigation algorithm and platform validation.
